e.title: verified-reserving (Lean 4)
e.summary: 机器验证的精算准备金数学（Lean 4，Apache-2.0）：Mack/Munich 链梯、ODP、BF、信度、Panjer 递推全部形式化证明
e.body: verified-reserving 是用 Lean 4 定理证明器对准备金与精算风险数学做机器验证的项目（Apache-2.0，无 sorry/自定义公理，CI 审计 479 个命名声明的证明依赖）：覆盖 Mack 与 Munich 链梯、随机 ODP、一年期理赔发展、Bornhuetter-Ferguson、Bühlmann-Straub 信度与 Panjer 递推。形式化证明包括：发展因子=个体因子加权平均、Mack 方差估计的自由度分解、Mack MSEP、Quarg-Mack 的 Munich 相关性调整恒等式（分离链梯保留付/收比例的系统性缺口）、以及精确复现 Mack (1993) 表 1 的数值（Taylor-Ashe 三角形，总准备金落在印刷值 18,681 的最邻近千位区间内）。对 RIAA：『数学证明也能机器验证』的前沿范式——精算算法的形式化保证。与 [[chainladder]]、[[profileladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]] 互补（方法 vs 证明）。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

e.summary_en: Machine-checked actuarial reserving mathematics in Lean 4 (Apache-2.0): Mack/Munich chain ladder, ODP, BF, credibility, Panjer recursion — all formally proved
e.summary_hk: 機器驗證的精算準備金數學（Lean 4，Apache-2.0）：Mack/Munich 鏈梯、ODP、BF、信度、Panjer 遞推全部形式化證明
e.body_en: verified-reserving is a project that machine-checks claims-reserving and actuarial risk mathematics with the Lean 4 theorem prover (Apache-2.0, no sorry/custom axioms, CI audits the proof dependencies of 479 named declarations): covering Mack and Munich chain ladder, stochastic ODP, one-year claims development, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Bühlmann-Straub credibility and Panjer recursion. Formal proofs include: the development factor as the weighted mean of individual factors, the weighted sum-of-squares decomposition giving the degrees of freedom of Mack's variance estimator, Mack's MSEP, the Quarg-Mack identity behind the Munich correlation adjustment (separate chain ladder preserving each row's paid/incurred ratio — the systematic gap), and an exact reproduction of Mack (1993) Table 1 numerics (Taylor-Ashe triangle; the summed reserve lands in the nearest-thousand interval printed as 18,681). For RIAA: the frontier paradigm that 'mathematical proofs can also be machine-verified' — formal guarantees for actuarial algorithms. Complements [[chainladder]], [[profileladder]] and [[reserving-ensemble]] (methods vs proofs). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
e.body_hk: verified-reserving 是用 Lean 4 定理證明器對準備金與精算風險數學做機器驗證的項目（Apache-2.0，無 sorry/自定義公理，CI 審計 479 個命名聲明的證明依賴）：覆蓋 Mack 與 Munich 鏈梯、隨機 ODP、一年期理賠發展、Bornhuetter-Ferguson、Bühlmann-Straub 信度與 Panjer 遞推。形式化證明包括：發展因子=個體因子加權平均、Mack 方差估計的自由度分解、Mack MSEP、Quarg-Mack 的 Munich 相關性調整恆等式（分離鏈梯保留付/收比例的系統性缺口）、以及精確複現 Mack (1993) 表 1 的數值（Taylor-Ashe 三角形，總準備金落在印刷值 18,681 的最鄰近千位區間內）。對 RIAA：『數學證明也能機器驗證』的前沿範式——精算算法的形式化保證。與 [[chainladder]]、[[profileladder]]、[[reserving-ensemble]] 互補（方法 vs 證明）。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
